body:
This modpack was used in Chrono SMP. 

A server modpack that is sure to take you on a wild ride, from biplanes to massive airliners, this modpack has it all. Play with friends or by yourself with endless possibilities and nothing to stop you, run wild. The more you play the better it gets, make giant builds or live peacefully in the place you call home. You can do anything and create anything, fly planes across dangerous terrain or just boat down the river. Whatever you do have fun, and stay happy.

(Can be used on SMP's)


This modpack contains some following mods (these are no all of them)

-Immersive aircraft
-Aviator Dreams
-Immersive instruments
-Armor Poser
-Carry on
-Capes
-Dungeons and Taverns
-Just mob head
-Just player heads
-Jade
-JEI
-Immersive Paintings
-Moar discs
-LambDynamicLights
-Nifty Carts
-Xaero's Minimap
-Xaero's World Map
-Yungs Better dungeons
-Yungs Better End Island
-Yung's Better Jungle Temples
-Yungs Better Mineshafts
-Yung's Better Strongholds

AND MORE!!
